publishedRecipe.name: Avocado White Bean Toast with Cheddar

instructions.primary_message: Drain and rinse beans in a colander; set aside to drain further.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Halve and pit the avocados. Cut into chunks while still in the skin, then scoop out into a medium bowl.
Juice lemon into the bowl with the avocado.
Peel and mince garlic; add to the same bowl.
Add beans and spices to the bowl with the avocado; mash until well combined but still slightly chunky.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ tsp thyme
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide toast between plates, top with cheese, avocado-bean mix, and tomatoes. Enjoy!
